valeRules.description: warns on passive voice ("was edited", "were deployed")
warns when a heading immediately follows another heading with no prose between them — uses scope: text with a multiline regex
requires an acronym to be spelled out on first use, with an exception list for acronyms common enough to skip (API, HTML, URL, and similar)
enforces sentence-style capitalization in headings, with an exception list for proper nouns and product names (TypeScript, Kubernetes, macOS, and similar)
